experience.title: Lead Full Stack Developer

experience.text: After joining the agency as a Full Stack Developer, I moved into the lead role and designed and developed client websites and web applications. I also developed a reusable WordPress plugin and introduced Google Analytics and Data Studio reporting, collaborating through Jira, ClickUp, Slack and Git.
